messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the regional failover postmortem. We need owners and firm dates for remediation items: routing guardrails, snapshot verification, runbook clarity, and a short game-day exercise. Keep replies brief and claim ownership.

kevin: I'll own routing guardrails. Scope: prevent mass route withdraws during tests, add a staged withdraw mechanism, and expose a route-convergence metric. Target: PR by 2026-03-04, canary next week.

sasha: I will rewrite the restore runbook. Deliverables: clear step-by-step commands, expected outputs, triage flow for partial restores, and a pre-check checklist. Draft by 2026-03-02.

anil: I'll build a snapshot verifier job that checks checksums and does a small restore/verify in staging. Cadence: nightly for EU, weekly global. ETA: 10 business days.

ops-runbooks: Runbook checklist to include:
- Preconditions: snapshot age <24h, ops notified.
- Step 1: quiesce writes: "POST /api/maintenance"
- Step 2: restore: "./restore --id $SNAP --region eu --verify"
- Step 3: run health checks: /healthz, sample inference.
- If route convergence >3m -> rollback route changes.

maria: Good. Add alert on verifier failure (2 fails in 24h) and a dashboard panel for "DR readiness" (last successful restore, verifier pass rate, route convergence p95).

kevin: I'll add the route-convergence metric and propose an SLO of 3 minutes for warm-standby traffic shift.

anil: I'll add Grafana panels for verification pass rate and last restore. Will hook alerts.

maria: Proposed DR dry-run: Wed 2026-03-11 09:00 PT. Short window to exercise restore + routing switch. Can everyone hold that?

kevin: +1

sasha: +1, runbook pre-read ready.

anil: +1, verifier in staging by then.

maria: Milestones recap:
- Routing guardrails: kevin - PR by 2026-03-04
- Restore runbook: sasha - draft by 2026-03-02
- Snapshot verifier: anil - staging by 2026-03-08
- DR readiness dashboard: kevin+anil - baseline by 2026-03-10

kevin: I'll also draft a one-page post-game checklist to capture lessons and owners immediately after dry-run.

sasha: Adding cache warm-up step to runbook to avoid serving stale model shards after partial restore.

maria: I'll open a GH project with these items and assign owners + milestones. Posting link here when ready. If timelines slip, update this thread with new ETAs.

deploy-bot: Reminder set: DR dry-run on 2026-03-11 09:00 PT in #incidents.

kevin: Thanks all — small scoped work and a short game-day should reduce recurrence. :rocket:
